headline: Fishermans Row Renews Fighting; DeadLands Churns On
war_summary: Since the last edition, the line has shifted again. Fishermans Row, silent through the afternoon watch, has returned to the ledger with five recorded actions in the past two hours, Peripti Landing and Dankana Post drawing the heaviest traffic; the latest blow fell at 20:35. DeadLands, which had gone quiet, stirred once more toward evening, its six-hour tally rising to five with The Salt March and Callahan's Boot prominent, though the newest two-hour window shows no further moves. Godcrofts remains busy, eight actions on the day and its most recent at 19:50, but its two-hour count has cooled to one. Farranac Coast, the previous edition's flashpoint, has fallen still since 17:50; Linn Mercy and Lykos Isle show no fresh base business since the early morning. Away from the base board, Clahstra and Weathered Expanse still run a fearsome butcher's bill, with casualty rates accelerating, yet no strategic bases have changed hands there. The war stands on its seventy-seventh day.
